primitives.name: commitOverlay
primitives.when: Reach for this to press one run's tracing paper down: it stages the sandbox's changes and swaps them into the project by rename, refusing loudly on mid-run conflicts.
primitives.signature: commitOverlay(opts: object) => {committed: string[], skipped: {path: string, reason: string}[]}
primitives.fails: Throws (writing nothing) when any changed file was also changed in the project mid-run, unless onConflict is `skip`; throws on unsupported file kinds and on a project that moved mid-commit. A phase-2 failure undoes every journaled step: a full undo reports `nothing was applied`, a partial one throws `SBX_COMMIT_FAILED` listing exactly the steps not undone and keeping the commit folder (originals in `old/`) named in the error. Setuid/setgid bits are stripped from committed modes; mtimes are not preserved. A killed commit leaves a folder that blocks the next diff/commit/setup until removed.

primitives.name: createProxy
primitives.when: Reach for this HARNESS-ONLY to run the front door: it terminates agent TLS, sees every request, and parks the ones a human must decide. It decides nothing itself; pair with the launcher for sandboxes and `sbx` for decisions.
primitives.fails: Throws synchronously on a missing `logFile` or `runtime`. Throws when another live proxy owns the runtime; a dead owner's claim is taken over. At runtime, dead upstreams, malformed input, over-cap and timed-out holds all become loud logged HTTP errors, never silence and never a crash. A second proxy on the same port rejects `ready`, never crashes the process.

primitives.name: diffOverlay
primitives.when: Reach for this to review one run's tracing paper: it lists every file the sandboxed run added, modified or deleted, flagging the ones the project changed meanwhile.
primitives.fails: Throws when no overlay exists for the agent, when the project is gone, when a leftover commit folder blocks, or when the overlay view cannot be mounted; never writes anything.

primitives.name: launch
primitives.when: Reach for this to HARNESS-ONLY start one sandboxed agent run: it creates the sandbox the agent lives in. It does not decide anything; combine with the proxy for the front door and the gate (M3) for policy. Pass overlay:true for a writable tracing-paper run (M4). The agent starts in the project dir.
primitives.fails: Throws synchronously on a missing/empty `runtime`, `agent`, `proj`, or `command`, on a bad agent name, on a non-integer `proxyPort`, on an over-long socket path, when `socket` disagrees with `<runtime>/socks/<agent>.sock`, when `runtime` IS `HOME` or the project dir (its sockets could not be hidden from the agent), or with overlay on when the runtime sits inside the project or uncommitted changes linger. The child fails at runtime (nonzero exit) when `bwrap` or `socat` is missing inside, or when nothing listens on the agent socket.

primitives.name: rollbackOverlay
primitives.when: Reach for this to throw one run's tracing paper away: it drops every sandboxed change and leaves the project exactly as it was.
primitives.signature: rollbackOverlay(opts: object) => {discarded: OverlayChange[], exact: boolean, why: string|null}
primitives.fails: Throws when no overlay exists for the agent or its record is corrupt, or when the overlay folder cannot be removed even after a permission repair (the error names the folder). Listing the changes never throws and never invents entries: an unlistable upper reports `discarded: []` with the reasons in `why`. Removal depends on neither listing nor the first permission pass: a partial failure retries removal once after a fresh permission pass. Dropping the upper never touches the project.

primitives.name: run
primitives.when: Reach for this to HARNESS-ONLY run one sandboxed agent start-to-finish in a single call: it starts the proxy, sandboxes the command, answers holds, and returns the exit code with the ask and audit trail (plus the overlay diff once M4 exists).
primitives.signature: run(opts: object) => Promise<{ exit: number, asks: AskRecord[], audit: string, diff: OverlayChange[], runtime: string }>
primitives.fails: Rejects on a missing/unreadable `proj`, an empty `command`, a bad `mode`, a misshapen `onAsk`, a proxy that never becomes ready, a `launch` that throws (uncommitted overlay changes, a runtime inside the project — the proxy is closed first), or an overlay diff that cannot be read. The agent's own nonzero exit is returned as `exit`, never thrown.
primitives.example:
import { run } from "barebox";
const { exit, asks, audit } = await run({ proj: "/tmp/proj", command: ["bash", "-c", "echo hi"] });
